question.problem: The total area of forest, in hectares, is given by the function $f(t)=700+3t-4{t}^{3},$ where $t$ is the time, in years, since measurements began. What is the average rate of loss of the area in the first $5$ years?
question.worked_solution:
Let $f(t)=700+3t-4{t}^{3}$ be the total area of the forest, in hectares, after $t$ years. To find the average rate of change of the forest area over the first $5$ years, we use the average rate of change formula on the interval $[0,5]$:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{Δf}{Δt} & =\frac{f(b)-f(a)}{b-a} \\  & =\frac{f(5)-f(0)}{5-0} \\  & =\frac{700+3(5)-4(5)^{3}-(700+3(0)-4(0)^{3})}{5} \\  & =\frac{15-500}{5} \\  & =-97\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the average rate of forest loss over the first $5$ years is $97$ hectares per year.
